name: eng114-regional-1024m-soak-30min-deferred
description: Sustained-load run of the full 4096-cell seed-1 authoritative world with eight regional deferred-catalogue clients, all links unshaped, clients 0 and 1 repeating the outbound/return movement path. From tick 3000 for 108000 ticks, 18000 ordinary radius-2 terrain cuts (10 per second) and 180 radius-8 (4 m diameter) blasts (one per 10 s) at positions drawn from a fixed LCG (seed 0xE114) over x,z in [600,3500) at y=16, spread round-robin over all clients; world resets at ticks [36000, 72000]. Every scripted cut must commit and every client must finish with the server's exact final hash. Not the G4 population (256 active / 4,096 sleeping bodies), whole-foundation collapse or GPU acceptance. Links are unshaped: a shaped regional client resolves only about 0.3 distant edits per second (each costs a ~33 KB dense-brick repair over a ~22 KB/s link), so this edit rate with impaired clients is outside what the protocol carries today; impaired links are covered by the lighter fixtures.
